summary: Friday is the day, and it's a road-trip day — Matunuck and Ditch both light up with prime-angle SE swell to 4ft-plus and favorable offshore/cross-off wind, cleanest at Matunuck. Rockaway is small but glassy and fine for a home-break log session, but if you can swing the drive today is clearly worth it over the neighborhood. It fades and turns junky from the weekend on: cross-on and onshore winds dominate Sun through Thu, so grab it now before the flat, textured spell sets in.
